info.title: API Documentation
info.description:
Bitlink API

### Standard API response format

All JSON API responses are wrapped in a common envelope.

Successful responses:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {},
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "uuid",
    "timestamp": "2026-07-04T09:15:22Z",
    "version": "1.0",
    "processing_ms": 25
  }
}
```

Error responses:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Validation failed.",
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR"
  },
  "errors": {},
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "uuid",
    "timestamp": "2026-07-04T09:15:22Z",
    "version": "1.0",
    "processing_ms": 25
  }
}
```

Paginated responses put pagination details in `meta.pagination`.

tags.name: Checkout Templates
tags.description: Templates define payment settings, customer fields, settlement method, UI/callback settings, and allowed payment methods. Use them to create checkout sessions.

tags.name: Checkout Sessions
tags.description: Checkout sessions are payment attempts created from templates. Use initialize for API-only checkout, or create a session and open the hosted widget/page for hosted checkout.

get.description:
Returns the currently authenticated user
based on the provided Sanctum access token.
Returns paginated checkout sessions created from the given template. Use this for backend reconciliation and support tooling, not for high-frequency payment polling.

post.description: Creates a hosted checkout session. Put template source=api fields in source_values. Put optional customer defaults in prefill_values.
Creates and submits a checkout session. Put source=api fields in source_values and source=by_customer fields in collected_values.
post.summary: Initialize the payment in one step.

get.description: Returns a checkout session created from the given template. Use this for setup/inspection flows; use the lightweight status endpoint for polling payment progress.

Lightweight polling endpoint. It syncs blockchain/invoice state and returns only ids, statuses and payment amounts. It intentionally does not return QR code, wallet details, or full session/order payloads.

post.description: Submits customer values for an existing session. Put only source=by_customer fields in collected_values.

collected_values.description: Map of source=by_customer field keys to final customer values.

post.description: Creates a retry session when the original session is expired, cancelled, failed, or has a retryable overdue invoice. Use the returned session public_id for hosted checkout or submit it for API-only payment instructions.

get.description: Returns paginated checkout templates for the merchant attached to the current API token. Use this to find a template id/public_id before creating checkout sessions.

post.description: Creates a checkout template for the merchant attached to the API token. Mutating requests should include Idempotency-Key. The field_schema controls which values are supplied by API, predefined by the template, or collected from the customer.

get.description: Returns one checkout template. The path parameter accepts either the internal id or public_id of a template owned by the current API token merchant.

patch.description: Partially updates checkout template settings. Use PATCH; PUT is intentionally not exposed to avoid duplicate API operations. Existing checkout sessions keep their template snapshot and are not changed retroactively.

delete.description: Archives the checkout template. The template must be disabled first; call deactivate before archive/delete. Use deactivate when you only need to stop creating new sessions, and archive/delete when the template should disappear from normal listings.

post.description: Switches the template to active status. Only active templates can create new checkout sessions.
Switches the template to disabled status. Disabled templates cannot create new checkout sessions. Existing sessions keep working according to their own state.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

selected_payment_method_code.description: The payment method codes available in the template settings. Example: USDT.TRON.TRC20
The payment method codes available in the template settings. Example: USDT.TRON.TRC20

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
